bagPolicy.summary: For U.S. Rolling Loud festivals, bags must generally be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches. One-gallon clear freezer bags, small clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches, and empty clear hydration packs are also allowed.
allowed: clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
small clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches
prohibited: non-clear backpacks, purses, or bags outside the listed exceptions
bagPolicy.note: This is Rolling Loud's current policy for all U.S. festivals.

parking.summary: Accessible parking spots on site are limited and first come, first served, and you need to buy a parking pass on the event website. Bring a valid state-issued handicap placard, permit, or license plate, and the person it was issued to must be in the vehicle.

rideshare.note: No current Los Angeles-specific rideshare guidance was confirmed on Rolling Loud's official site. Use the official event guide if a Los Angeles edition is announced.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible routes connect parking, entrances, stages, accessible viewing areas, and vendors, but there is no transportation between stages. Bring your own wheelchair or scooter, since rentals aren't offered, and recharge mobility devices at the Accessibility Services Hub. Email ada@rollingloud.com with questions.
